name: django-newadmin-assets
description: Build tools for the django-newadmin static assets

scripts.build:css: sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=import --no-source-map --style=compressed --load-path=node_modules assets/scss/newadmin.scss src/newadmin/static/newadmin/css/bootstrap.min.css && sass --no-source-map --style=expanded assets/scss/theme.scss src/newadmin/static/newadmin/css/newadmin.css && node scripts/build-css-license.mjs
